name: self_repo_guard_heredoc_specs
notes: Heredoc spec extraction (delimiter/strip_tabs/execute_as_shell per heredoc in a shell line). Harness links the REAL C port (self_repo_guard.o + approval.o for iter_shell_command_starts/strip_shell_word_syntax/deobfuscate_shell_word_for_detection) and traces its per-spec result shape; twin imports LIVE tools/self_repo_guard.py::_heredoc_specs. Out-of-path externals (audit_log_security, tirith_inline_scan, url_is_safe, etc.) are stubbed in the harness - none are on the traced path. Covers: bare/quoted/tab-strip delimiters, quoted-away operators, ';;' command separators, '<<<' rescan behavior, unterminated operator, sh -c execute_as_shell=True path, non-shell interpreters, heredoc-free lines. 14 inputs. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (input dropped, FAP-worthy): for 'sh -c <<SH' LIVE computes execute_as_shell=True while the C port yields False - the execute_as_shell helper chain (srg_shell_script_arg/_SHELL_EXECUTABLES ladder) disagrees on shell '-c' flags with no script arg. That input is excluded from this gate's walk and flagged here for a follow-up port fix.
